FOREST CORPORATION AND ANR. A v. DY. COMMISSIONER OF INCOME TAX, LUCK.NOW NOVEMBER 27, 2007 B [ASHOK BHAN AND ALT AMAS KABIR, JJ.) Income Tax Act, 1961: ss.11 (J)(a), 12 and J 2A-Assessment of income-Application for registration under s. l 2A pending before Tribunal-Claim for exemption under 11 (l)(a), registration under s. l 2A is must-Assessee not registered under s. l 2A hence not entitled to exemption under s. 11 (l)(a)-Tribunal before whom application for registration pending D to take up matter on priority basis and decide same expeditiously­ Order of High Court remanding
